quests.title: Fruit for the Carriers
quests.text: My carriers have enough to argue with on the Skyglass paths before lunch joins in. Bring me six Melons for them. Fruit does not demand a toll, and everyone understands the part where you eat it.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft NA1: Nalo's first task at 50 (F10 sends Yarra's players).

quests.title: A Message That Arrives
quests.text: A shouted message is very good at reaching the person standing beside you. Read the carriers' prepared message knots at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/carrier_clearing} and tell me what word they have left for the next crew. I would like to know where help is needed without asking half the canopy to shout back.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft NA2: a use at the new recipe place P7; the early 51-60 potion choice.

quests.title: Roots Under the Load
quests.text: A root that holds a passing foot may think differently about a carrier and a full pack. Use the sighting frame at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/receiving_stand} to judge the crossing under load, then tell me how it bears the weight. I listen to the roots, but I also look at where they bend.

objectives.label: Sight the root crossing under load

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft NA3: a use at the new recipe place P8; Kezamba's weapon (a solo quest).

quests.title: Promises with Bowstrings
quests.text: Paymaster Chirr promises his archers wages for holding land, then pays them in branded coin for every mark they burn into living roots. His payroll lists both banners, and he makes the forest carry the debt for their dead. Kill four Last-Pay Archers or Ash-Writ Bowmen in all at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, by day or night, and kill Chirr. Smother the burning rootmark at {name:r20_anchor_084} to erase the names scorched there; the roots have complained about it louder than the spirits.
quests.completion: Huskell kept that watch on duty, and Chirr paid for its names to be burned into living roots; you have stopped his hand and smothered that mark. The tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077} still holds its claim. Return to Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch: she knows which names must come off the stone, and roots should not have to speak for our dead.

quests.title: Party: More Than One Voice
quests.text: Serpent Glass-Throat has grown fat among the burnt roots of the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. The canopy spirits stop talking whenever its coils move; even my drum gets a very careful answer. Gather a party and kill the elite serpent, so the next song from those branches can use more than a whisper.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft NA4 (K11 A): the optional group quest on Glass-Throat, standalone from its level; its id and objective stay, its prerequisite goes; a trinket choice.
